questions.q: How does Gilbert suggest you handle fear while following your passion?
a: Let it ride alongside curiosity without steering you
questions.why: She says put fears in the backseat and let curiosity take the wheel.

questions.q: According to the summary, what purpose does fear serve?
a: It reminds you of what matters to you
questions.why: She says fears give feedback about important things.

questions.q: What first step does Gilbert recommend before starting a creative project?
a: Give yourself permission to begin even if it’s imperfect
questions.why: She went ahead and gave herself permission despite doubts.

questions.q: Why keep a regular job while pursuing art, per the book?
a: It provides financial safety that lets you create without stress
It replaces the need to create
questions.why: She argues a day job pays bills and frees creative work from financial pressure.

questions.q: What problem does the cliché 'artist’s life' create, according to the summary?
a: Financial pressure that drains creative energy
questions.why: He says it often chokes creativity due to stress of paying bills with art.
